Population.evidence_source: [/page/7/Text/3] Eight of the 20 students (including some of those who had attempted suicide) had discussed suicide with their parents or girlfriends but again, the seriousness of their intent had not always been evident and had only become apparent in hindsight. Self-harm needs to be distinguished from suicide attempts (Spandler & Warner, 2007), but two of the male students who died were known to have self-harmed in the period leading up to their deaths.
